question: In which tournament in 2018 did Neeraj Chopra become the first Indian javelin thrower to win a gold medal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Asian Games**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Neeraj Chopra** made history by becoming the **first Indian javelin thrower** to win a **gold medal** at the **Asian Games 2018**.
 
• The event took place in **Jakarta, Indonesia** during the **18th edition** of the Asian Games.
 
• Neeraj achieved this remarkable feat with a **throw of 88.06 meters**, which was not only his personal best at the time but also set a new **national record** in javelin throw. *Hence, the correct option is Asian Games.*
 
• This victory solidified Neeraj Chopra's position as one of the top athletes in Indian sports history and brought immense pride to the nation.
 
• None of the other options – **Asian U20 Championships**, **Olympic Games**, or **World Championships** – were the events where Neeraj secured this prestigious gold medal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Neeraj Chopra:**

 
 
• **Neeraj Chopra** is a distinguished Indian track and field athlete specializing in **javelin throw**.
 
• He was born on **December 24, 1997**, in **Khandra village, Haryana**.
 
• Neeraj has become a symbol of Indian sportsmanship and is celebrated for his numerous achievements, including his historic gold medal at the **Tokyo Olympics 2020**.
 
 
 
• **Asian Games:**
 
 
• The **Asian Games** is a multi-sport event held every four years and features athletes from across Asia.
 
• The 2018 Asian Games were held in **Jakarta and Palembang, Indonesia**, from **August 18 to September 2, 2018**.
 
• Neeraj Chopra’s gold medal in **javelin throw** at the 2018 Asian Games was part of India’s strong performance, where Indian athletes won a total of **69 medals**.
 
 
 
• **Other Achievements:**
 
 
• Neeraj Chopra won the **gold medal** at the **Commonwealth Games 2018** in Gold Coast, Australia, with a throw of **86.47 meters**.
 
• He became the **first Indian track and field athlete** to win a gold medal at the **Olympic Games** in **Tokyo 2020**, achieving a throw of **87.58 meters**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Asian U20 Championships:**

 
 
• Neeraj Chopra did participate in the **Asian U20 Championships**, where he showcased his talent as a young athlete. However, it was not the tournament where he won a gold medal in 2018.
 
 
 
• **Olympic Games:**
 
 
• Neeraj Chopra won a historic gold medal at the **Tokyo Olympics 2020**, but this event took place in **2021** due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
 
 
• **World Championships:**
 
 
• Neeraj Chopra has been a strong contender at the **World Championships**, securing a silver medal in 2022. However, he did not win a gold medal at this event in 2018.
